title: Be Positive
subtitle: Build everyday wellbeing with small practices, without forcing positivity or pretending every setback needs a silver lining.

title: Do It
subtitle: Reduce the friction between intending and starting: clearer next actions, better cues, and fewer productivity rituals.

title: Skill Sprint
subtitle: Learn by practising the part that matters: retrieval, feedback, application, and review.

title: Be Healthy
subtitle: Everyday health and movement practices with clear evidence and safety boundaries — not diagnosis in a nicer font.

title: Phrases
subtitle: Useful words for boundaries, persistence, and difficult moments — chosen for the situation, not pasted in as motivation wallpaper.

title: Be Creative
subtitle: Generate more varied ideas, change context when it helps, and separate idea generation from evaluation.

title: Be Calm
subtitle: Low-risk ways to work with everyday stress. Calm is a useful state, not an on-demand performance metric.

title: Mood & Low Mood
subtitle: General wellbeing practices for mood and daily functioning, with sensitive guidance kept separate from professional mental-health care.

title: Fear & Confidence
subtitle: Practical ways to understand fear, approach manageable challenges, and build confidence without promising fearlessness.

title: Stoicism
subtitle: Use Stoic ideas as a lens for control, perspective, and action — philosophy first, motivational mythology second.

title: Money
subtitle: Small experiments for spending, saving, planning, and financial decision hygiene — not individualized financial advice.

title: Antifragility
subtitle: Use antifragility as a strategic lens for optionality, downside limits, and learning from manageable stressors.

title: Language
subtitle: Practise vocabulary, retrieval, feedback, and real use instead of collecting language-learning tricks.

title: Future Builder
subtitle: Turn a future goal into assumptions, controllable next moves, and review points you can actually revisit.

title: Talk Smart
subtitle: Make communication clearer: listen accurately, choose the right medium, rehearse hard conversations, and repair misunderstandings.

title: Relationships
subtitle: Build better conversations, boundaries, repair, and shared routines without pretending one script fixes every relationship.

title: Avoid Errors
subtitle: Reduce avoidable mistakes with checks, constraints, review points, and less faith in memory at the worst possible moment.

title: Fit Life
subtitle: Make movement easier to repeat with small, measurable routines and realistic evidence boundaries.

title: TRIZ
subtitle: Use TRIZ patterns to reframe constraints and generate alternatives when ordinary brainstorming is going in circles.

title: Data
subtitle: Use simple measurement, uncertainty, and comparison to make decisions without pretending every number deserves a dashboard.

title: As QA
subtitle: Borrow QA habits for everyday work: define failure modes, make rejection cheap, and test before trusting.

title: Marketing
subtitle: Clarify audience, value, message, proof, and distribution without turning ordinary communication into growth-hacking theatre.

title: Heart Health Basics
subtitle: General educational material about everyday cardiovascular-health habits; not diagnosis, treatment, or a substitute for medical care.

title: Insider
subtitle: Practical shortcuts and context that are useful because they remove friction, not because they sound secret.

title: As Architector
subtitle: Design environments, information flows, and constraints so the system helps instead of requiring daily heroics.

title: Chef
subtitle: Borrow mise-en-place thinking: prepare inputs, sequence work, reduce switching, and clean the system as you go.

title: As Detective
subtitle: Separate observations from stories, test competing explanations, and look for the clue that would change your mind.

title: Quantum
subtitle: Explore real quantum ideas without turning physics into life-coaching metaphors.

title: Work
subtitle: Design clearer work systems, decisions, handoffs, and reviews instead of collecting productivity rituals.

title: NLP
subtitle: Explore NLP-inspired communication ideas critically and treat them as heuristics, not established psychological mechanisms.

title: Thinking
subtitle: Frame problems, separate claims from evidence, generate alternatives, and build better checks around judgment.

title: Writing
subtitle: Plan, draft, revise, and get useful feedback without turning every sentence into a content strategy.

title: Grow fast
subtitle: Run small growth experiments, review the signal, and keep what works instead of chasing transformation streaks.

title: Grandmaster
subtitle: Borrow chess habits for planning, trade-offs, tempo, and looking one move beyond the obvious reply.

title: Game Theory
subtitle: Model incentives, alternatives, repeated interactions, and what the other side is likely to do next.

title: Psychodynamic
subtitle: Psychodynamic-inspired reflection prompts for patterns and past influences, kept separate from clinical treatment claims.

title: Metacognitive
subtitle: Metacognitive-inspired ways to notice how attention relates to worry and repetitive thinking, with clinical claims review-gated.

title: Cognitive Analytic
subtitle: Cognitive-analytic-inspired reflection on repeating patterns and relationships, without presenting self-help prompts as therapy.

title: Positive Psychotherapy
subtitle: Positive-psychology-inspired practices around strengths and positive experiences, kept separate from clinical treatment claims.

title: Body-Oriented
subtitle: Body-awareness practices for noticing tension and physical experience, with health and treatment claims kept review-gated.

title: Ericksonian
subtitle: Explore story, reframing, and suggestion as communication ideas without treating them as a substitute for professional therapy.

title: Gestalt
subtitle: Gestalt-inspired awareness and reflection practices, presented as educational prompts rather than clinical treatment.

title: Exposure
subtitle: Evidence-aware education about approaching manageable fears gradually, with safety and clinical boundaries made explicit.

title: DBT
subtitle: DBT-inspired educational skills for everyday coping and communication, kept separate from diagnosis and treatment.

title: ACT
subtitle: ACT-inspired practices for values, acceptance, and useful action, with clinical treatment claims kept review-gated.

title: CBT
subtitle: CBT-inspired educational practices for examining thoughts and testing useful actions, not self-administered diagnosis or treatment.

title: Grow Together
subtitle: Practical relationship routines for shared goals, repair, and cooperation without pretending one script fixes every conflict.

title: Cognitive Biases
subtitle: Recognize predictable reasoning shortcuts and design checks that make the mistake harder to repeat.

title: Stratagema
subtitle: Use classic stratagems as a lens for constraints, incentives, and asymmetric moves — not as a permission slip for manipulation.
